# truenas_s3_access_key (Data Source)

Looks up a TrueNAS S3 access key by name (s3.accesskey.query; TrueNAS 27.0 and later). The secret is not exposed.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the access key to look up.

### Read-Only

- `access_key` (String) Access key id.
- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 UTC creation time.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the key may be used.
- `expires_at` (String) RFC3339 expiry, null when the key never expires.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the access key.
- `last_used_at` (String) RFC3339 UTC time of the last accepted request; null when never used.
- `local` (Boolean) Whether the account is local.
- `manage_buckets` (Boolean) Whether the key may create and delete buckets.
- `status` (String) ENABLED, DISABLED or EXPIRED.
- `user_identifier` (String) uid (local) or SID (directory services) of the account.
- `username` (String) Account the key belongs to.
